title: Brake Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Brake Inspection And Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Brake Inspection Checklist covers brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification. The brake service advisor records Brake Inspection And Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Brake Inspection Checklist keeps Brake Inspection And Service exceptions visible until the brake service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Brake Inspection Checklist at service bay, lift, wheel positions, controlled test area, and customer handoff. Document brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification identity before Brake Inspection And Service begins. Compare brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification findings with stated Brake Inspection And Service criteria; route unresolved Brake Inspection And Service issues to qualified brake-system reviewer. For Brake Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Brake Inspection And Service. Ask qualified brake-system reviewer to review Brake Inspection And Service conditions beyond the brake service advisor's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Brake Inspection And Service, identify responsible parties, service bay, lift, wheel positions, controlled test area, and customer handoff, and the linked brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification source.

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Brake Inspection And Service facts for brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Brake Inspection And Service evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Brake Service Advisor both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Brake Inspection And Service when braking capacity, hydraulic integrity, component condition, authorization, or safe verification remains unresolved. Retain the available Brake Inspection And Service proof and route unresolved brake assembly, friction material, rotor or drum, hydraulic control, parking brake, and stopping verification scope to brake service advisor.
